verdict.rationale: Lithic is a REST API-first platform with a documented sandbox that mirrors production for running cards, transactions, and webhooks end-to-end (lithic-docs-5, lithic-docs-15), plus explicit API versioning controls (lithic-docs-7, lithic-docs-19) — all of which support headless, scriptable automation suitable for CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration, SDK usage in automated test suites, or example pipeline configs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD examples or SDK docs referencing automated test/build pipelines, and independent confirmation of headless sandbox usage in CI.
